اقتصرتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَرَتَا (iqtaṣaratā) /iq.ta.sˤa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اُقْتُصِرَتَا (uqtuṣiratā) /uq.tu.sˤi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
